title: Your godly confidence is a threat to the enemy. That’s why the attacks get louder when you finally step into your calling. 🔥
paragraphs: Your godly confidence is a threat to the enemy. That’s why the attacks get louder when you finally step into your calling. 🔥

The world will call it arrogance. They will try to humble you because your certainty makes them uncomfortable. But true confidence isn’t about thinking you are better than anyone else; it’s about knowing exactly who God is within you.
Don't shrink back just because your armor is shining too brightly for their eyes. Keep charging.
⚔️ “Therefore do not cast away your confidence, which has great reward.” — Hebrews 10:35 (NKJV)
Are you ready to stop apologizing for your boldness?
